blocks.value: Storing five test scores means five variables. Fifty means fifty, and you cannot write a loop over variables named `score1` through `score50`.
An array gives many values **one name and a number**, which is what makes loops and data meet. This is the lesson where Lesson 7 pays off.
What you will be able to do
By the end of this lesson you will be able to:

items: Declare, create, and initialize one-dimensional arrays
Traverse an array with a `for` loop and an enhanced `for` loop
Work with two-dimensional arrays in rows and columns
Understand multidimensional arrays as arrays of arrays
Use the `Arrays` class for sorting, searching, filling, and comparing
